home.title: Workspace
home.description: Every task is organized around a delivered artifact. Start a package from one of the three task types, or open a project to continue existing work.

generate.title: Generate & revise
generate.description: Draft a new document or revise an existing version from selected materials.
generate.input: Minimum input: goal + readable materials or a base version

review.title: Independent review
review.description: Review an exact material or package version against a review basis.
review.input: Minimum input: version to review + review basis

compare.title: Version comparison
compare.description: Establish section-level correspondence and list what changed between two exact versions.
compare.input: Minimum input: two exact versions + comparison direction

attention.title: Waiting for you
attention.hint: Packages that need a decision or input from you
attention.emptyText: No package is waiting for a decision right now. Start a task or open a project to continue existing work.

recentProjects.title: Recent projects
recentProjects.emptyText: This demo workspace has no project. Create the first project to organize materials and packages.

recentPackages.title: Recent packages
recentPackages.hint: Most recently updated packages across all projects
recentPackages.emptyText: Create a package to see it here. Every package belongs to a project.

noProjects.title: This demo workspace has no project yet
noProjects.text: Create a project to keep materials and packages together, or try one of the three task types directly. Everything stays in this browser.

projects.title: Projects
projects.description: Projects group materials, packages and delivered versions. Search by name, code or description.
projects.noMatchText: No project matches your search. Clear the search to see all projects.
projects.emptyText: Create the first project to start organizing materials and packages in this demo workspace.

project.notFoundText: This project does not exist or is no longer present in the current demo data.
project.taskbarTitle: Start a task in this project
project.taskbarHint: The project is preselected; the task wizard asks for the remaining inputs.
project.attentionEmptyText: This project has no package waiting for a decision.
project.recentPackagesEmptyText: Create a generate, review or comparison package for this project.
project.materialsEmptyText: Add materials so review and comparison tasks have readable inputs.
project.relationsHint: Relations become visible only after a package delivers a formal version.
project.relationsEmptyText: Deliver a formal version to create review, revision or comparison relations.

packagesTab.emptyText: Create a package to start a task. Every package keeps its own stages, versions and relations.
packagesTab.noMatchText: No package matches the current filters.

addVersion.title: Add a new version?
addVersion.text: A new version will be added and become the current version. Previous versions are kept in the version history.
addVersion.done: New material version added. It is waiting to be parsed.

delete.title: Delete this material?
delete.text: The material is removed from this project. Historical packages that referenced it are not deleted, but their references will show as unavailable.

materials.emptyText: A generate task can start without materials. Review and comparison tasks need readable materials.
materials.noMatchText: No material matches the current search and filters.

drawer.title: Material details
drawer.partialText: Only part of this file could be extracted. Read the parse note before using it as evidence.
drawer.failedText: This version failed to parse, so no content is shown. The demo environment does not parse real files.
drawer.pendingText: This version has not been parsed yet. The demo environment does not upload or parse files, so there is no readable content.
drawer.parsingText: Parsing is still in progress in this demo. No content is readable yet.
drawer.noDocumentText: This version has no readable document attached.
drawer.simulateHint: These buttons only change the local simulated parse state. No file is uploaded or parsed.

addModal.title: Add material
addModal.name: Material name
addModal.usageNotePlaceholder: Why this material is in the project (optional)
addModal.uploadHint: Demo environment: only the local file name and size are recorded. No file is uploaded to a server and no parsing is performed.
addModal.done: Material added. Its first version is waiting to be parsed.
